concept: Noticing small good things in an ordinary day
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character has an ordinary day and notices several small good things they usually overlook
exercise.reflection_prompt: What small good things did the character notice?
exercise.practice: Student names three small good things from their own day

assessment.success_marker: student names three specific things, not vague statements
